newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Novo 1996 profit seen 16.6 pct up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Novo 1996 profit seen 16.6 pct up.

text.p: Nine analysts polled by Reuters forecast on Monday full year 1996 pre-tax profits almost 17 percent up on 1995 for Danish pharmaceuticals and biotechnology group Novo Nordisk.

The panel forecast on average a pre-tax profit for Novo Nordisk in 1996 of 2.515 billion crowns, 16.6 percent up on 1995's 2.156 billion crowns. They foresaw turnover 6.3 percent higher than in the previous year at an average 14.594 billion crowns.
In November, Novo Nordisk, one of the world's leading producer of insulin and industrial enzyme products, posted 1.893 billion crowns pre-tax profits for 1996's first nine months.
At that time turnover stood at 10.725 billion crowns and Novo reiterated then previous forecasts of 10-15 percent higher whole year 1996 pre-tax profits.
The panel's forecasts are thus more optimistic than Novo Nordisk's own expectations. Novo Nordisk is due to announce its 1996 results on Wednesday March 12.
